counting_rule: Each frozen semantic request contributes at most one semantic observation. An eligible first transport timeout contributes transport evidence only. If its single exact-byte retry is accepted, that accepted response supplies the semantic observation for that frozen cell.
evidence_rule: Both the first transport failure and any retry attempt must be preserved in the execution receipt.
failure_rule: If any semantic request remains unaccepted after its permitted retry, or fails for any non-retryable reason, the preregistered 54/54 adjudicability gate fails and semantic interpretation is withheld.
purpose: Prevent one observed transient NVIDIA NIM transport timeout from censoring an otherwise frozen semantic measurement cell, without changing the semantic request or decision rule.
